messages.subject: Adding Text to Vertical (Horizontal) Line
parts:
Dear All,
Please look at the code snippet at the end of the email. I am adding a
vertical line to an existing geometry (histogram, boxplot, does not
really matter here).
Now, what I would like to be able to do is to add efficiently both a
vertical (horizontal) line and some text sitting on that line (and be
able to fine tune the text: color, font size etc...).
Is there any quick way to do this with ggplot2?
Many thanks

Lorenzo


#################################################

library(ggplot2)
library(Cairo)


set.seed(1234)
x <- (1-runif(10000))^(-1.5)
x <- x[which(x<=1e5)]
xf <- as.data.frame(x)
names(xf) <- "mydata"

ratio_min <- length(which(x<=1e5 & x>= 104.5))/length(x)
ratio_max <- length(which(x<=100.5 & x>= 100))/length(x)

gpl <- ggplot(xf,aes(x=mydata))+
geom_histogram(aes(y=..count..), binwidth=0.5, colour="darkgreen",
fill="white")+
geom_vline(xintercept = log10(3600))+
scale_x_continuous(trans = "log10")+
scale_y_continuous(trans = "log10", limits=c(1,10000))+
xlab("Contact Duration (sec)")+
ylab("Pairwise Number of Contacts")+
opts(axis.title.x = theme_text(size = 20))+
opts(axis.title.y = theme_text(size = 20, angle=90))+
opts(axis.text.x = theme_text(size=15, colour="gray",vjust=1))+
opts(axis.text.y = theme_text(size=15, colour="gray", hjust=1))


CairoPDF("my_data_bin_plot.pdf")
print(gpl)
dev.off()
